name: In-Brick DDA for Occlusion
definition: A Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) that marches through a 4x4x4 voxel brick to determine if any solid voxel occludes a shadow ray. Unlike primary hit resolution, it visits ALL solid voxels to handle transparent/fringe cases correctly.
summary: In-Brick DDA for Occlusion is a fixed 4x4x4 voxel brick traversal algorithm that checks all solid voxels for shadow occlusion, unlike primary hit resolution which stops at the first intersection.
